title: Nameless Cults

[[Image:NamelessCults.png|right|160px]]
'''Nameless Cults''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 1 [[movement]] point to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-1) check]].  If you pass, draw 1 [[Spell]], lose 1 [[Sanity]], and discard Nameless Cults.  If you fail, nothing happens.

'''Price''': $3

==Mythos Source==
Nameless Cults (a.k.a. Unaussprechlichen Kulten) first appeared in ''The Children of the Night'' (1931), written by Robert E. Howard.
